checklist.evidence: Uses `DateTimeOriginal`, then `DateTimeDigitized`. ... Formats are JPEG, HEIC and common RAW (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG)
Skip files without a date | Fall back to file modified time ... M2 adds `--fallback=mtime`, off by default
Name clashes get deterministic suffixes (`_1`, `_2`), and an existing file's name always counts as taken.
Dry run is the default. `--apply` is required to change anything
checks that the source still exists and that the target is free (case-insensitively), then calls `os.rename`
Every applied run writes a journal. `photo-rename undo` reverses it exactly
EXIF local time is used as recorded, with no time-zone conversion
Grouping by base name (RAW+JPEG, `.xmp`/`.aae` sidecars, Live Photo `.mov` follows its HEIC)

traps.evidence: Before each rename, it checks that the source still exists and that the target is free
never use `DateTime`, because editing software overwrites that field.
Reads headers only and never opens files for writing.

note: Strong, well-scoped, safety-first plan with early spikes and clear reversibility reasoning. Its main gaps are leaving OffsetTimeOriginal unused and deferring sidecar/RAW handling to M2.
